name: kubiq-docs
description: Reference for Kubiq's documentation library (_docs/) — the same-commit update duty, where a document goes, the frontmatter schema, the docs-* tooling and every lint rule, and the rules for reorganising the library, the decision register and the backlog. Use when finishing any code change, writing or updating a document, adding a Dnn decision or a Gnn backlog row, running or fixing `just docs-lint`, or moving/splitting anything under _docs/.
